messages:
Maria Chen: claiming Tue 09:00 slot for the routing-service change (small config + model swap). I plan a canary at 10% for 15m, then 50% if green. I will run smoke and post results here. pinging @kevin and @sophie for rollback coverage and smoke ownership.
Jon Patel: thanks — which components exactly? is this just the routing lambda + inference-target config, or is there a DB migration too?
Maria Chen: just routing-service + model key rotation, no schema changes. no DB migration.
Riya Singh: FYI there's an ongoing infra flag flip in staging at 08:30, could interfere with canary metrics. can we shift to 09:30 if needed? :thinking_face:
Maria Chen: noted. leaning 09:00 still but will move to 09:30 if infra isn't stable by 08:45. will post final call by 08:50.
Deploy Bot: slot reserved: Tue 09:00 - owner: Maria Chen. Reminder scheduled at 08:45. See /deploy-queue for details.
Kevin O'Neill: I'll be smoke owner. Will watch latency, 5xx, and the error budget dashboard. If anything > 0.5% 5xx over 5m I will signal rollback.
Sophie L: What's the backout command? Want to have it handy in case Kevin flags rollback.
Maria Chen: backout is quick — run the restore script on the traffic-router:

```
kubectl -n prod set image deployment/traffic-router traffic-router=traffic-router:vstable-20260301
# or use infra runbook: /runbooks/traffic-router-rollback
```

I'll also keep the canary TTL short so it's easier to revert.
Jon Patel: PR is merged to staging, infra flag PR is open and awaiting review. tagging @deploy-ops to watch for the flag flip.
Riya Singh: thanks — I'll review the flag PR now, should be quick.
Sophie L: tagging #deploy-queue and will add myself to the smoke rota. :thumbsup:
Maria Chen: perfect. I'll post the final go/no-go at 08:50 with a short checklist: 1) infra flag stable 2) smoke owner ready 3) metrics green in staging. If any fail we shift to 09:30.
Kevin O'Neill: copy. I will drop a quick smoke checklist when slot starts.
Maria Chen: thanks everyone — will update if anything changes.
